sentences.text: Today we will talk about Lithuania.
Lithuania is a small and beautiful country in Northern Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Lithuania?
Lithuania is in Northern Europe.
It is part of a group of countries called the Baltic States.
The other two Baltic countries are Latvia and Estonia.
Lithuania is next to Latvia, Poland, Belarus and Russia.
It also has a coast on the Baltic Sea.
What is the capital city of Lithuania?
The capital city is Vilnius.
Vilnius is the largest city in Lithuania.
It has old buildings, churches and a famous old town.
Many tourists visit Vilnius to see its beautiful streets and history.
Other cities in Lithuania include Kaunas, Klaipeda and Shialiae.
How many people live in Lithuania?
About two, eight million people live in Lithuania.
It is not a very big country.
Many people live in cities, but some live in small towns or villages.
Lithuania is a peaceful and green country.
What language do people speak in Lithuania?
People in Lithuania speak Lithuanian.
Lithuanian is the official language.
It is one of the oldest languages in Europe.
Some people also speak Russian, Polish or English.
English is taught in schools and many young people speak it.
What is the weather like in Lithuania?
Lithuania has four seasons.
Spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Spring is fresh and green.
Summer is warm and sunny.
Autumn has colorful trees and cool air.
Winter is cold and snowy.
In winter, people wear warm coats and boots.
In summer, they enjoy nature and festivals.
What does Lithuania look like?
Lithuania has forests, lakes, rivers and fields.
It is a flat country with some small hills.
The land is very green in spring and summer.
There are many national parks and nature reserves.
It is a great place for walking, biking and camping.
What animals live in Lithuania?
Lithuania has many wild animals such as deer foxes, wild boars, hares, wolves.
There are also many birds, frogs and insects.
In the forest, people pick mushrooms and berries.
What do people eat in Lithuania?
Lithuanian food is warm and filling.
People eat a lot of potatoes, cabbage, beets, meat, bread.
Some traditional dishes are sepulani, potato dumplings with meat, shaltabarsh jack, cold beetroot soup, pink in color, coogalus, baked potato pudding.
Kept a Duana fried rye bread with garlic, a snack.
For dessert, people eat cakes, honey pastries and fruit.
They drink tea, coffee and sometimes kefir, a yogurt drink.
What is life like in Lithuania?
Life in Lithuania is peaceful and friendly.
People enjoy quiet time, nature and family.
They go to work or school during the week.
On weekends, they relax, visit family or spend time outside.
In the countryside, people grow food and take care of animals.
In the cities, life is more modern and busy.
What are some holidays in Lithuania?
Independence Day, March 11th.
St.
John's Day, Joniness, June 24th with bonfires and songs.
Christmas, December 25th with food, lights and family.
Easter with painted eggs and traditions.
All Saints Day, November 1st when people light candles in cemeteries.
People also enjoy folk music, dancing and festivals in summer.
Some fun facts about Lithuania.
Lithuania was the first country to lead the Soviet Union in 1990.
The flag is yellow, green and red.
The Hill of Crosses is a famous place with thousands of crosses.
Lithuania has over 6,000 lakes.
Basketball is the most popular sport.
The national team is very strong.
Now you know many things about Lithuania.
You know where it is, what people speak and how they live.
You learned about food, weather, holidays and animals.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
